description.value: Rhodos Coffee & Bistro is a downtown Courtenay cafe that pairs an on-site micro-roastery — sourcing beans from small independent farms worldwide — with a gourmet all-day breakfast and lunch bistro. Established in 1993, it is known for house-made specialties using free-range eggs, local ingredients, and freshly roasted coffee. The space also serves as a rotating gallery for Comox Valley artists, making it a culturally rich stop for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 62m; rack (2 spaces) at 64m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rhodoscoffee.ca is active and consistently presents the business as 'Rhodos Coffee & Bistro' with address '364 8th St., #103, Courtenay, BC V9N 1N3' — both differ from OSM ('Rhodos Coffee Roasting Company', '368 8th Street'), flagged as concerns. Phone number (250) 338-5592 matches OSM. Takeout is confirmed by a dedicated 'Takeout at Rhodos' navigation page and contact-page language about takeout cutoff times; no bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Rhodos Coffee Roasting Company' but website consistently uses 'Rhodos Coffee & Bistro'.
Address mismatch: OSM has '368 8th Street' but website shows '364 8th St., #103, Courtenay, BC V9N 1N3' — used website address as more specific and current.
Contact email on website (dale@hangar31.com) appears to belong to sister cafe Hangar 31 rather than Rhodos directly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active downtown Courtenay cafe with on-site roastery, all-day food service, and confirmed takeout — a solid fueling stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: Established in 1993... on-site micro-roastery... gourmet all-day breakfast and lunch bistro
